verdict.rationale: Notte's docs have a dedicated Playwright page stating that sessions expose a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) endpoint you can connect to with Playwright. That covers the core of bringing existing Playwright or CDP code to its cloud browsers (notte-docs-11, notte-docs-24). Missing for 10: explicit Puppeteer documentation (only implied by the CDP endpoint), in-depth connection details or code samples in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts run unmodified.
